content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Primary Constructors** as part of **Classes, Objects, and Object-Oriented Fundamentals**. Classes group state and behavior; primary constructors and properties keep ordinary domain models concise, while initialization order still matters. Use the subtopics—Constructor Parameters, Properties in Primary Constructors, Constructor Initialization—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.

items.title: Constructor Parameters
items.text: Constructor Parameters should support a clear object invariant: make valid states easy to represent, restrict mutation to the intended API, and keep initialization and dependencies explicit.
